name: io.github.baramundisoftware/bconnect-mcp
title: baramundi bConnect
description: baramundi Management Suite (bMS) via the bConnect API: endpoints, jobs, software and more

packageArguments.description: all, or domain names separated by commas: activedirectory, assets, compliance, defensecontrol, endpoints, groups, jobs, operatingsystems, servermanagement, software, universaldynamicgroups, updatemanagement, variables

environmentVariables.name: BCONNECT_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: bConnect URL of your bMS, with https:// and the port

environmentVariables.name: BCONNECT_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: bConnect API key; or set BCONNECT_USERNAME and BCONNECT_PASSWORD instead

environmentVariables.name: BCONNECT_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: bMS user for Basic authentication, with BCONNECT_PASSWORD, if no API key is set

environmentVariables.name: BCONNECT_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Password for BCONNECT_USERNAME, ASCII characters only

environmentVariables.name: BCONNECT_RELEASE
environmentVariables.description: Fallback when the bMS release can't be read at startup

environmentVariables.name: BCONNECT_CA_CERT_PATH
environmentVariables.description: PEM file of the CA that signed the bMS certificate, if Node.js doesn't trust it

environmentVariables.name: ALLOW_WRITE_OPERATIONS
environmentVariables.description: true enables tools that change the bMS (off by default)

environmentVariables.name: ALLOW_SECRET_READ
environmentVariables.description: true enables tools that read secrets such as BitLocker keys (off by default)
